sources: TanStack postmortem, GHSA-g7cv-rxg3-hmpx, and the Snyk, Wiz, StepSecurity, and Aikido write-ups. 84 malicious versions across 42 @tanstack packages were published between 19:20 and 19:26 UTC on 2026-05-11; the window end is an estimate from published detection times and is flagged as such. Malicious version publish times were read from the live npm registry time map on 2026-08-19, where they survive even though the versions were removed.
